This size 7 engagement ring features a 1.22 ct round halo of clear cubic zirconia stones. Crafted from rhodium-plated 925 sterling silver, the piece includes a micro-pavé band. It is hypoallergenic, nickel-free, and comes in a leather presentation box.

This One Piece Sabo anime-themed wallet case is compatible with iPhone 11, 11 Pro, and 11 Pro Max models. It is made from shockproof TPU and PU leather and features three card slots, a cash pocket, and an auto wake/sleep function. The design includes a multi-angle stand and precise cutouts for all ports.

specs.Compatibility: Casement, tilting, and bottom hung windows

record.description: This 158-inch waterproof nylon window seal is designed for casement, tilting, and bottom-hung windows. It uses adhesive hook tape and a zipper to secure portable air conditioner or tumble dryer hoses, blocking outside air from entering the room. The kit is washable, easy to install without drilling, and fits various hose diameters.

This 19” x 24” kitchen mat features a low-profile, absorbent polyester surface and a waterproof, slip-resistant backing. It is designed to protect countertops from spills and scratches while providing a stable area for drying dishes and cookware. The durable mat is machine washable, made in the USA, and includes over 50% recycled fibers.

The Jiee Tec SUNTEK Solar Panel provides backup power for Suntek series hunting trail cameras. It features a built-in lithium polymer battery, a safeguard circuit for protection, and an IP 65 waterproof rating. This compact, deep-colored panel is suitable for outdoor use and can be mounted on trees, poles, or tripods.

These black Russell Athletic men's mesh shorts feature a 9-inch inseam and an X-Large size. They are constructed with breathable mesh and Dri-Power moisture-wicking technology. The shorts include an elastic waistband with an internal draw cord for an adjustable fit and side pockets for small items.

This white long-sleeve blouse features a slim fit and a ribbed knit construction. It includes a cross wrap design with an asymmetrical neckline and a pullover style. Made from a polyester, cotton, and spandex blend, this machine-washable top is suitable for various occasions.

These clip-on heel wheels attach to regular shoes to create roller skates for children aged 6 and up. The wheels feature LED lights that activate during motion without the need for batteries. Designed to support up to 132 lbs, they are fully adjustable and include a rubber strap and large brakes.

specs.Compatible Surfaces: Plastic, whiteboard, glass, paper, wood, metal, ceramic

record.description: This white matte Chartpak Graphic Art Tape roll measures 1/8 inch wide by 324 inches long. It features a permanent adhesive suitable for indoor and outdoor use on surfaces such as wood, metal, glass, and paper. It is designed for creating solid lines on charts, crafts, decorations, and signage.

specs.Dimensions: 54.53 L x 29.92 W x 18.90 H Inches

record.description: This wood toddler bed from Delta Children features a Nick Jr. PAW Patrol design. Suitable for children aged 15 months and older, it includes two high side rails for safety. The JPMA-certified bed measures 54.53 x 29.92 x 18.90 inches and is designed for easy assembly.

This set includes two ivory sheer curtain panels, each measuring 52 by 84 inches. Made from linen-textured fabric, these curtains feature a grommet top and a bottom hem. They allow light and airflow into a room while providing privacy. These machine-washable panels are suitable for use in bedrooms or living rooms.

This 11 x 14 inch Amazon Basics whiteboard features a magnetic dry erase surface and a lightweight aluminum frame. It includes a black marker with a built-in eraser, two magnets, and self-stick pads for mounting. The board can be hung horizontally or vertically to display notes, lists, or photos.

This 12-piece set includes five sandwich bags, five snack bags, two large storage bags, and two sealing clips. Made from food-grade, BPA-free PEVA material, these transparent, leakproof bags are suitable for freezing, refrigerating, and organizing food or personal items. They are hand-wash only and not dishwasher or microwave safe.

This Carter's 7-pack contains long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls in size 18M. The set features assorted colors and patterns. Each bodysuit includes strong snaps designed for durability during regular wear and washing.

specs.Key Ingredients: Amla fruit extract, proline, glycine, hyaluronic acid
specs.Allergen-Free: Free of soy, nuts, fish, and shellfish

record.description: PlantFusion Collagen Builder is a vegan, gluten-free vanilla protein powder designed to support collagen production, skin hydration, and joint health. It contains amla fruit extract, proline, glycine, and hyaluronic acid. This non-GMO formula is free from dairy, soy, and nuts, and can be mixed into smoothies or coffee.

specs.Fragrance Notes: Pumpkin puree, sweet butter, vanilla cream

record.description: This set includes six Bath & Body Works Sweet Cinnamon Pumpkin Wallflower refill bulbs, packaged as three twin-packs. The fragrance features notes of pumpkin puree, sweet butter, and vanilla cream. These bulbs are compatible with Wallflower Fragrance Plugs and Night-Lights. This is a discontinued scent.

specs.Included Items: Candy, Cookies, Chocolates, Wafers, Biscuits, Pretzels
specs.Origin Countries: Russia, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, Ukraine, Latvia, Macedonia

record.description: This snack box contains at least eight pre-packaged treats from various Eastern European countries, including Russia, Romania, and Croatia. The assortment features a variety of items such as candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, and pretzels. Each box offers a different combination of authentic flavors and types.

This black skull-shaped gear shifter knob is made from resin and aluminum alloy. It is designed for most manual and automatic vehicles with shifter levers between 8mm and 12mm in diameter. The package includes three adapters, a spanner, and four screws to facilitate installation.

This ivory set includes 200 plastic pearls in three sizes (20mm, 14mm, and 10mm) without holes for a smooth appearance. It also comes with six packets of transparent water gels to make the pearls float in vases. These reusable decorations are suitable for home decor, weddings, and other events.

specs.Included Items: Modes Bassinet Stroller, SnugRide SnugLock 35 Infant Car Seat

record.description: The Graco Modes Bassinet Travel System in Wynton includes a stroller that converts into an infant bassinet, an infant car seat carrier, and a toddler stroller. It also comes with a SnugRide SnugLock 35 infant car seat. The system offers nine riding options and a one-step attachment for the car seat.

This white, hi-grade plastic tray is designed to hold 24-inch flower boxes. It is lightweight and fade-resistant, providing a protective surface for decks, patios, or indoor areas. Measuring 22.25 inches long by 6.5 inches wide, this tray is made in the USA.

This light blue undershelf storage basket features a steel metal frame with a rust-resistant PE finish. It includes snug fit arms designed to attach to cabinets, desks, or other shelves to create additional storage space. The medium-sized basket measures 10.25 x 16 x 5.5 inches and weighs 12 ounces.

This 24k gold-plated heart locket measures 0.75" x 0.5" and can hold up to two photos. It is available with or without an 18-inch curb link chain. Made in the USA, the locket comes in a black velvet pouch and includes a lifetime replacement guarantee.

specs.Nib: 23 K Gold Plated Steel Fine Nib

record.description: This Kaweco fountain pen is handmade in Nuremberg, Germany, from high-quality brass. It features a 23 K gold-plated steel fine nib and weighs 21 grams. The pen measures 13 cm with the cap attached and offers a soft writing feeling.

WENDY LASHES blue easy fan volume lash extensions feature a 0.07mm thickness and lengths ranging from 14-20mm. These self-fanning lashes are heat-treated for stable curls and include a special root treatment to prevent separation. They are designed for technicians learning the volume by hand technique.

This weathered white wall-mounted coat rack by Ilyapa features five metal hooks on a distressed wood base. Measuring 24 by 4.5 inches, it has a 30-pound weight capacity. The product includes mounting hardware and is suitable for organizing coats, hats, and bags in various areas of the home.

specs.compatibility: Fishing, hunting, and duck hunting waders

record.description: Constructed from 1/4-inch stainless steel, this wader hanger features a chain design capable of supporting over 200 pounds. It allows users to hang fishing, hunting, and duck hunting waders off the ground to facilitate faster drying. This helps maintain the waders' shape and can extend their service life.

specs.Exterior: Bonded fleece with grid knit texture

record.description: This Spyder men's jacket is constructed from 100% polyester. It features a bonded fleece exterior with a grid knit texture and a Sherpa fleece lining. The design includes a full zip closure, two side zipper pockets, and embroidered branding on the front and back.

These pet stairs are suitable for small, medium, and large dogs to reach elevated furniture. They are constructed from blow-molded plastic and feature a removable carpet tread. The stairs have a slight incline to help pets reach higher surfaces.

specs.Functions: Black ballpoint, red ballpoint, pencil, stylus, eraser

record.description: This Cross Tech3+ multifunction pen features a satin black finish with chrome accents. It includes a black ballpoint, red ballpoint, 0.5mm pencil, stylus, and eraser. The pen allows for up to 25 characters of custom engraving that looks silver and comes with a lifetime mechanical warranty and a gift box.

This black short-sleeve t-shirt features the "Raider True 'Til The Day I'm Through" design. Made by Smack Apparel Inc., the shirt is constructed from 100% pre-shrunk cotton and screen printed in the USA. It is machine washable and comes in size X-Large.

specs.Footbed: Soft EVA with anatomical arch support

record.description: These aqua and green Reef sandals for little kids feature a soft EVA footbed with anatomical arch support. They are built with flexible Triple Density EVA and a vegan leather upper strap with a jersey lining. The high density EVA outsole provides multi-directional traction.

This white adidas kids' Real Madrid home jersey features a regular fit with a straight silhouette and short sleeves. Constructed from 100% recycled polyester doubleknit, it incorporates sweat-wicking Climalite fabric and mesh inserts under the arms. The jersey includes a crewneck and a woven team crest.
This Hyperkin cable connects all Saturn models to HDTVs, supporting 720p resolution for clear audio and video. The set includes a 7 ft. cable and a 6 ft. micro cable.

These replacement lenses are designed to fit Oakley Holbrook sunglasses with model numbers starting with OO9102 in the 55mm size. They feature a dark silver mirror coating with 6% light transmission, are polarized, and provide UV protection. The 1.4 mm thick lenses meet ANSI Z80.3 standards. This set includes two lenses only.

The Bionica Nimah thong sandal features fabric straps and a soft nubuck toe post. It includes a quick-drying molded EVA footbed with arch support, a heel cup, and a toe bar. The design is completed with a shock-absorbing EVA midsole and a durable, slip-resistant rubber outsole.

This jumbo pet bowl from JW Pet Company is designed for extra large breed dogs. It features a heavyweight construction and a rubber bottom to prevent sliding on smooth surfaces. The bowl is dishwasher safe and available in various colors.

This officially licensed LEGO Batman grid wall poster by Trends International measures 22.375" x 34". Printed on FSC-certified gloss poster paper, it features high-resolution artwork. The unframed poster is suitable for various rooms and can be displayed using poster mounts, clips, or thumb tacks.

This three-pack of Carter's toddler tank tops for boys features blue stripe, orange gators, and gray stripe designs. The sleeveless shirts include a ribbed neckline and a pocket detail. These 3T tops come in tagless packaging.

This pack of 75 BOX USA double wall Gaylord bottoms measures 48" L x 40" W x 36" H. Made from 275# D.W./ECT-48 kraft corrugated material, these containers are designed to hold bulky or irregularly shaped items. They are compatible with Gaylord lids and are shipped flat in pallet quantities.

specs.charging: External USB port and headphone hole

record.description: This black Seoky Rop sling bag is made of water-resistant PU leather and features adjustable nylon straps. It includes multiple compartments, an anti-theft interlayer, an external USB charging port, and a headphone hole. Measuring 13.8 x 6.7 x 3.2 inches, this lightweight bag is suitable for travel, work, and daily use.

This 5.5-inch resin figure depicts an older woman and a young girl sitting on a bench and holding hands. Hand-painted and based on an original carving by Susan Lordi, the piece comes in a fitted gift box with an enclosure card. It is suitable for display on a shelf, table, or mantel.

The Leatherman Surge is a heavy-duty stainless steel multitool equipped with 21 tools, including large pliers and spring-action scissors. It features a unique blade exchanger, replaceable wire cutters, and one-hand opening capabilities. This all-locking tool includes a premium nylon sheath and is backed by a 25-year warranty.

This white short-sleeved chef's jacket for women features a double-breasted design with a 10-button closure. It includes a matching chef hat with Velcro fasteners that fit sizes XS through XXL. This item is size small and can be worn both ways.

These 3MM neoprene gloves from DiNeop are designed for water sports such as snorkeling, kayaking, and surfing. They feature a flexible, form-fitting design with an anti-slip palm for a secure grip. The gloves include an adjustable velcro strap and are blind-stitched for added durability and thermal protection.

specs.Care: Machine washable cold, tumble dry low

record.description: WallFlower Women's Juniors denim shortalls in Belle feature adjustable straps, a center zipper closure, and multiple pockets. These size small shortalls have a 3-inch cuffed inseam and are made with LYCRA. They are machine washable in cold water and can be tumble dried on low.

The LENTION CB-C31 is a space gray USB-C hub featuring four USB 3.0 ports with data transfer speeds up to 5Gbps. It supports up to 60W Power Delivery and is compatible with various devices, including MacBook, Surface, and Chromebooks. The aluminum alloy housing includes an LED indicator and EMI protection.

This official Alex Grey poster features the Oversoul artwork. The museum-quality print measures 18 by 24 inches and includes a quote about human consciousness being a bridge between planetary and cosmic consciousness.

The ALPS Mountaineering Low Rocker Chair features a powder-coated steel frame and breathable TechMesh fabric. This foldable chair weighs 11 lbs, supports up to 300 lbs, and includes a shoulder bag for transport. It features a low-profile rocker that locks into place for stability. Dimensions are 22" W x 17" D x 31" H.

This pack of two Size D batteries is official merchandise from Trick Or Treat Studios and Universal Studios. Designed as an accessory for the Good Guys Doll, these batteries are based on onscreen and behind-the-scenes footage from Child's Play 2.
